title: Ukraine Claims First Combat Use of Domestically Produced FP-7 Ballistic Missile Against Russia
detail: Ukraine claimed its first combat use of the domestically produced FP-7 ballistic missile against Russia on October 2, 2026, marking a significant milestone in Ukraine's indigenous weapons development capability. The FP-7 represents a major step toward reducing Ukraine's reliance on Western-supplied munitions for deep-strike operations inside Russian territory.

title: Putin Calls PM Modi's Ukraine Peace Initiative 'Good' in Diplomatic Signal
detail: Russian President Vladimir Putin praised Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi's peace initiative to end the Russia-Ukraine war, calling his ideas 'good' — a notable diplomatic signal amid ongoing conflict. The statement underscores India's continued efforts to position itself as a potential mediator between Russia and Ukraine.

title: Ukraine Seeks Diplomatic Resolution with South Korea Over North Korea Tensions
detail: A Ukrainian minister sought to resolve a 'misunderstanding' with South Korea through diplomatic outreach, following tensions over Seoul's stance on North Korea's reported role in the Russia-Ukraine conflict. Ukraine has been pressing its allies to take a firmer line against North Korean military support to Russia.

title: Russia Planning Its Most Powerful Military Blow Yet Against Ukraine to Freeze Conflict
detail: According to New York Times reporting, Russia is planning its most powerful military blow yet against Ukraine, aimed at freezing the conflict. The anticipated massive offensive operation would be designed to force a ceasefire on terms favorable to Moscow, leveraging overwhelming force to shift the battlefield balance ahead of potential diplomatic negotiations.

title: Zelensky Claims Putin Ordered Russian Generals to Abandon Rules of War
detail: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky claimed that Russian President Vladimir Putin has told Russian generals to abandon the rules of war, marking a significant escalation in stated Russian military doctrine. The statement came ahead of anticipated large-scale Russian offensive operations and signals a potential shift toward more indiscriminate tactics targeting civilian infrastructure and population centers.
